requirements: R1: Fix systemic synchronization failure between internal 'done' statuses and closed GitHub PRs.

slices.title: Patch GitHub PR status synchronization logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR sync fix for this epic, I want to accurately map GitHub PR states to internal statuses, so that false 'done' statuses are eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task linked to a GitHub PR
When the PR is closed without being merged
Then the internal system status is not marked as done
Then automated tests verify the correct PR state mapping
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive task completion rate to 0%
